compute_R2_metrics: compute R-squared metrics between true and predicted values for symbolic regression model evaluation
compute_accuracy_l1_metrics: compute accuracy L1 metrics with configurable absolute and relative tolerance thresholds for predictions
compute_error_metrics: compute MSE, RMSE, NMSE, and L1 error metrics between true and predicted symbolic regression outputs
compute_complexity_metrics: compute predicted tree complexity and relative complexity compared to ground truth trees
check_symbolic_solution: check if predicted values match true values as a symbolic solution using norm-based comparison
